description: ST. PAUL, MN – Today, the Minnesota House of Representatives passed the E-12 Education Budget and a standalone bill that funds unemployment insurance for hourly school workers like bus drivers, cafeteria staff, and paraprofessionals. “This budget agreement reflects our commitment to Minnesota’s students at a time when public education is under attack at the federal level,” […]
title: Release: Minnesota House Passes Education Budget and Standalone Bill Preserving Unemployment Benefits for Hourly School Workers - Youakim for State Representative
